name: Lion's Roar
reason: No usable contact route: every email on lionsroar.com (contact, customer care, about and membership pages) is Cloudflare-protected, which we never decode (owner, 10 Nov 2026), and the site has no contact form; only phone numbers and postal addresses are published.
